import json,time
from pathlib import Path
from nisayon.evaluation import evaluate_bundle
from nisayon.engine.io import write_json,file_digest
out=Path("artifacts/engine-integration-001/temporal-integration-001/confirmation-readback-002")
rows=[]
for case,expected in (("D01-gripper-sign","accepted"),("D05-recurrent-carry","rejected")):
 root=Path("artifacts/development-ablation-001")/case/"A/confirmation/execution"
 started=time.perf_counter()
 result=evaluate_bundle(root/"bundle.json",artifact_root=root)
 elapsed=time.perf_counter()-started
 p=out/(case+"-evaluation.json")
 write_json(p,result)
 codes=sorted({r["code"] for r in result["reasons"]})
 assert result["decision"]==expected,(case,result["decision"])
 if case.startswith("D05"): assert "progress_lost" in codes,codes
 rows.append({"case":case,"decision":result["decision"],"reason_codes":codes,"evaluation_wall_s":elapsed,"retained_evaluation_sha256":file_digest(p)})
report={"records":rows,"new_simulator_executions":0,"scope":"Read-only integrated evaluator on original actual stores; original decisions unchanged. Evaluation wall times are nested in the command receipt."}
write_json(out/"finite-readback.json",report)
print(json.dumps(report))
